name: BIANCA TELLE
reason: Health rule (12 Nov 2026), rechecked: even the Quantum-Touch-only route fails. Her QT seminar page (bianca-telle.de, therapie_qt-seminare) sells the course on dissolving pain and inflammation, aligning bones, back pain and 'hand positions for particular diseases' ('diverse Handpositionen für bestimmte Krankheiten'). Her QT-Wirkung page frames the work as raising 'sick energy' to self-heal patients. The rest of the site is a Heilpraktikerin natural-medicine practice with illness pages (RF-Krankheiten, Grabovoi Infomedizin, laser). This is the same reason as Paulo Mascarenhas Franco (3082).
